h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Siwan

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Siwan

items.pText: A new private school in Siwan has a lot to finish before the first session starts, and the playground is often planned last. It goes more smoothly if it is planned alongside the building. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, colonies and public spaces in Siwan, at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,400 km away.

Siwan is a district town in north-western Bihar, on the flat Gangetic plains near the Uttar Pradesh border, with hot summers and a wet monsoon. Equipment goes there by road, and a dealer in eastern India or our own team installs it. Share the school's site plan, the classes you will start with and a few photos. The layout we send back shows where each piece sits and the clear space it needs.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning a playground while the school is being built

c: Mark the play area on the site plan early, before the building contractor uses that land to store sand, steel or debris. Ask the contractor to level it and lay drainage while machines are still on site, as this costs less now than later.
Schedule installation after plastering and painting are done, so the equipment is not splashed or damaged. For a school opening with nursery and primary classes only, start low. Good first pieces are
, spring riders and a see-saw, and leave room for larger equipment as higher classes are added. See our

items.q: When should a new school order its playground equipment?
items.a: Plan it with the building, then order once the opening date is clear. Install after plastering and painting are finished so the equipment is not damaged by construction work.

items.q: Can we add more equipment as the school grows?
items.a: Yes. Our layout drawing can show the full play area, with space kept for later pieces. You order the first set now and add the rest as new classes start.
Yes. We send the equipment by road from our Vasai factory and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
